nativeHostFeatures: normal ldk-node chicory dependency, no lightning/_test_utils

iptables.rules:
-P INPUT ACCEPT
-P FORWARD ACCEPT
-P OUTPUT ACCEPT
-N CHICORY_RELAY_ONLY
-A OUTPUT -p udp -m owner --uid-owner 1000 -j CHICORY_RELAY_ONLY
-A CHICORY_RELAY_ONLY -d 127.0.0.11/32 -j ACCEPT
-A CHICORY_RELAY_ONLY -j DROP
